figurative_meaning_en: This life and the hereafter; all means of support
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার দুকূল গেল, কোনো আশ্রয় রইল না।
example_sentences_in_english: He lost both shores, with no support left.
One must secure the shores of life.
history: Derived from riverine imagery in Bengali proverbs, symbolizing total loss as in 'একূল-ওকূল দুকূল গেল অকূলপারে গোকুল'.
note: Often used in contexts of loss or security in Bengali folklore.
